 The Police Sub-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Sushma.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused married CW-1 on 22-10-2020.

At the time of marriage, as per the demands of accused No.1 to 3 and her family members had given one gold bracelet, gold necklace,
gold ring and silk sarees as dowry to accused.

The accused No.1 to  3  C.C.No.27213/2022 3 after the marriage with common intention have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty demanding her to bring additional dowry and they have also threatened to kill her.
Based on the information of Smt.Sushma. a case in Cr.No.204/2021 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.

Pursuant to the issuance Sushma W/O Viswamath vs Vishwanath on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153420859/
2 and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  abused and threatened her and thereby accused have  committed the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506of IPC.
 & Sec. 3 & 4 of D.P. Act.?
 2) what order?

sentences.text:
As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked  5  C.C.No.27213/2022 Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex. P.2
is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1.

She in her examination-in- chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 22-10-2020 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness Sushma W/O Viswamath vs Vishwanath on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153420859/
4 have turned hostile to the prosecution case.

sentences.text: Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon  6  C.C.No.27213/2022 other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 3 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 of IPC. & Sec. 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out C.C.No.27213/2022 taken by her is verified, corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 09-01-2025).
